content_descriptors.notes:
Marksman VR Demo contains frequent depictions of stylized violence. The player eliminates enemy targets using sniper rifles, which results in visible blood splatter effects.

There are no depictions of gore, sexual content, drug or alcohol use, or any non-consensual acts.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
